name: vision_eval_contract
why: The rubric's non-negotiable: the vision eval harness must compute precision/recall on the top signal from labeled samples and a hallucination rate, as runnable code. This fixture pins the harness's arithmetic on a frozen confusion set.

hallucination_probe.description: images verified to contain no pool, provider truck, or yard sign

expect.counts_check: TP+FP+FN+TN must equal universe (40); hallucination denominator is its own 20-image universe, not the 40
